summary:
## [1.5.1] - 2026-11-14

Release 1.5.1. **WLED** lighting and **lighting scenes**. WLED LED-strip controllers join the staff Lights pane,
the Lights step in presets and the `light` action, next to Philips Hue, Govee and DMX: local control over the venue
network, with no account or cloud. A **lighting scene** is one look across any mix of lights, whatever brand each
is, captured from what the lights show and recalled with one tap from the Lights pane, a preset, a schedule or a
button. WLED has been tested against stand-in controllers written from WLED's documentation, not yet on real ones
(see the bench checklist). Docs: user guide 4.10, 4.17 and 5, how-to 40 and 41, troubleshooting 10.

### Added

- **WLED plugin.** **Find** searches the network for WLED controllers (or add one by address); tick the ones staff
  may drive and pick a floor zone and a name. A controller is one light: on/off, brightness, colour and white, each
  only where its LEDs can do it. Picking a colour or white always shows that solid colour; white uses a strip's
  warm and cool LEDs where it has them and is mixed from colour otherwise.
- **WLED segments.** **Show segments** also lists each segment of a controller, as set up in WLED, as a light of
  its own with its own Staff tick, floor zone and name.
- **WLED presets as scenes.** The presets and playlists saved on a controller are its scenes on the Lights pane and
  in Lights steps. A preset saved later appears without a restart.
- **Live state.** Each controller keeps a live connection to the server, so a change made in WLED's own app or on
  a wall button shows on the panels at once. A controller with no free connection (an ESP8266 takes three) is read
  every few seconds instead, and the server does not compete with the venue's phones for one.
- **WLED details.** An optional fade for changes; a controller found at a new address is moved to it by the next
  Find; a row says when its controller is receiving live data (E1.31, Art-Net, DDP), which overrides other changes.
- **Lighting scenes.** A new preset step, **Lighting scene**, holds what each of a set of lights should show:
  Hue rooms, Govee lights, DMX groups and WLED controllers side by side, each with its own brightness and colour
  or white, or off. All of them change at the same moment. It is captured from what the lights show: **Capture
  again** re-reads them, **Add a light…** and **Take out** change which lights it holds.
- **Scenes on the Lights pane.** A preset whose steps only set lights gets a button at the top of the staff Lights
  section, as well as its place among the presets. Like any preset it can be scheduled or put on a button.
- **Setup checklist** row for WLED (listed only while the plugin is enabled), **System health** fix text, a
  **Control Devices › Lighting** card, and **demo mode** with two controllers (three shelf segments and a rail).
- **Network.** WLED controllers are reached on TCP 80. The search asks by mDNS from UDP 53530 on the server; on
  Windows the installer and the plugin open that port for the answers.
- **API.** Admin routes under `/api/plugins/wled` (search, controllers, segments), and the `light_scene` action
  wherever actions are accepted. Scene recalls are `light_scene` Audit rows.
- **Game day can work the other way round.** Admin › Audio › Master row › Game day › **While on**: _Hides the
